title: MqttMappingConfig
description: Configuration schema for the MQTT adapter mapping. Describes how MQTT PUBLISH and SUBSCRIBE intents are normalized into BASIS authorization requests. Topic matching is literal string equality (or the '*' sentinel) — no MQTT topic-filter matching is performed, and MQTT wildcards (+, #) in operation topics are preserved verbatim, never expanded.

routes.description: Ordered list of route mappings. Routes are evaluated in order; the first match wins.

MqttRouteMapping.description: Maps an MQTT operation and topic to normalized authorization semantics.

name.description: Optional human-readable route name. Must be unique across all routes in the config if non-empty.

operation.description: MQTT operation to match (protocol-native packet name). Use '*' to match any operation.

topic.description: Exact topic string to match, or '*' to match any topic. Comparison is literal string equality — the adapter performs no MQTT topic-filter matching.

action.description: Normalized action verb. If empty, the default operation→action map is used (PUBLISH→write, SUBSCRIBE→subscribe).

resource_id_template.description: Template for the resource ID. May reference {operation}, {topic}, {client_id}, {qos}, {payload_type} using {param} syntax.
